name: Tamala Takahashi
office: City of Burbank, Member of the City Council

items.text: Tamala Takahashi is Burbank’s mayor and a councilmember, elected in 2022. She works as a clinical therapist specializing in neurodivergence. She previously ran a nonprofit consulting business. During her term, she helped open a homelessness resource center with family transition suites, according to her campaign. Her campaign says she also led passage of a restaurant-supported plastics ordinance and a gas-powered leaf blower ban, and supported a large-scale solar array at the airport. Her platform emphasizes clean energy, small businesses, housing security, and mental health services. She serves on regional boards including the Southern California Association of Governments and the League of California Cities.
